source.name: Golf Business News: PING to sponsor LIV Golf's Torque GC team
source.quote: PING has announced that it is to sponsor LIV Golf’s Torque GC team which is captained by long-time PING tour staff player Joaquin Niemann.
source.note: Still a Torque GC partner in 2026: PING's logo is in the partner rail at livgolf.com/torque-gc (opened 2026-10-03).

source.name: AKRON: Our Sponsorships
source.quote: AKRON® Alliances Torque GC Torque GC is one of the standout teams in the LIV Golf League
source.note: Page without a date; opened 2026-10-03. AKRON's own sponsorships page lists Torque GC under 'AKRON® Alliances'.

source.name: LIV Golf - Torque GC team page
source.note: Night Dragon's logo sits in the partner rail at the bottom of the team page, linking to nightdragon.com; the partner logos are images, so there is no quotable text. Opened 2026-10-03.

source.name: LIV Golf: New Era Cap and LIV Golf announce multi-year partnership
source.quote: LIV Golf and New Era Cap, the iconic sports and lifestyle brand, today announced a multi-year partnership in which New Era Cap will become the Official Cap of the LIV Golf League.
source.note: The page dates the article only as '29 months ago'; the league-wide deal was reported in April 2024. New Era's logo still appears on every 2026 team page, including Torque GC's (opened 2026-10-03).

summary: Team partners 2026: PING, Akron, Night Dragon, New Era. Captain: Joaquin Niemann.
